Hii Richard

Alicia Kannekens passed me your contact 

I'm im Ivan Weiss Van Der Pol

Currently I am working on a project that I want to implement in paraguay

The idea is to make a robot that can move using gps information to traverse a patch of land 
As it moves It will drop mixed seeds of native trees 

The idea is to sell the service of my business planting trees 

Would you maybe know who I should market the service to?

Currently I'm thinking about marketing it to politicians and environmentally sustainable companies

And how much I should charge for the service?
Hello Ivan, nice to meet you. I'm not sure how I can help you with your plan. But a good first question would be if you already have a business plan?

I have worked mainly on the robot part of the project (I'm a computer science student)
And I was thinking of working on the business side when I get back to paraguay

The reason I started working on it already is because I want to participate in a  competition for entrepreneurs that is happening in my current university (Wichita state university, Kansas)

I read up a bit about business plan and made a basic one for the business 

Executive summary
Gogreen is a company that will provide the services of reforestation using gps guided rovers and pelletized seeds. Our mission is to fight climate change by trapping carbon In plants 

Services 
We provide our clients the means to plant trees in an efficient way 
Benefits of using robots
* Can work on any conditions (40°C+ temperature for prolonged time)
* Reduced costs and higher productivity (no need for food and amenities for the rovers and space previously used by humans can transport resources)
*Assurance of the area that was seeded 

Utilizing pelletized seeds 
We can improve the chanses of the seed growing in to a mature tree
We pelletize mixing the seeds with a mix of calcium potassium and nitrogen along with natural insect repellent 

Once the seed is in the ground and it gets rain the pellet traps the humidity creating the needed environment for the seed to sprout 

Strategy and implementation 
With a working full scale version I'll make Instagram videos and promote it digitally 

Also I want to present it in science/technology fairs and events where potential investors and clients are likely to be 


The costs for the Rovers is around 700 USD 
For the pellet ingredients I'll have to check the suppliers in paraguay


The operation would be 
1 a client provides the data of the location to be reforested along with what kind of trees are wanted 
2 we calculate price based on time (going there, working, coming back), area to be reforested, costs of expected seeds + ingredients
3 we pelletize the seeds and prepare it for transport
4 we load a car/bus with the disassembled rovers and the seeds, along with resources needed for the operator 
5 the operator arrives at the location verifies the gps coordinates and that the given perimeter is correct
And deploys the rover
Once the rover is running out of seeds or battery it returns to the operator for a recharge  and continues working
If there are problems (rover stuck) the operator will be in charge of fixing them 
6 once the rover is done it returns to the operator

Currently the number of roles are 
1 engineer (operator/builder of rovers)
1 marketing
1 operator of seed peletizer 

I'm not sure if more are needed

Extra ideas 
- camera on rover to make a time lapse video for promotion
- rover imediatly sprays water on pellets to give initial humidity conditions
- setup camera that autonomously takes 1 pic a day in a post overlooking job sites for  promotion


Would this be helpful?
